title: 6-year-old discovers rare fossil at Schramm Park
description: Six-year-old Leo Youngdahl of Eagle, Nebraska, has found a rare fossil at Schramm Park State Recreation Area.

title: Intl. Archaeology Day: A glimpse of Iran’s Paleolithic heritage and museums
description: TEHRAN - On 17 October, archaeologists and cultural institutions worldwide mark International Archaeology Day, highlighting archaeology’s contribution to our understanding of the human past. The occasion also invites reflection on the broader role of archaeology in reconstructing human history, investigating changing relationships between people and their environments, and communicating scientific knowledge to the public through museums and other cultural institutions.

title: 80 pct of ancient laterite wall restoration completed at Cambodia's Angkor Thom
80 pct of ancient laterite wall restoration completed at Cambodia's Angkor Thom
description: PHNOM PENH, Oct. 17 (Xinhua) -- An archaeological team has completed 80 percent of the restoration of Angkor Thom's centuries-old laterite wall within the UNESCO-listed Angkor Archaeological Park in Cambodia's Siem Reap province, an APSARA National Authority (ANA) news release said on Saturday.
